title: Forensic Accounting and Fraud Control
overview: Forensic accounting and fraud auditing are critical fields gaining prominence as fraud and accounting scandals become more widespread. This course bridges the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application, equipping participants with tools to detect and mitigate fraud. It empowers professionals to enhance organizational value through effective fraud controls and forensic analysis of data.
audience: This course is ideal for finance and accounting professionals, including controllers, accounting managers, senior accountants, analysts, and internal or external auditors, seeking to sharpen their forensic accounting and fraud detection skills.
methodology: The course employs a dynamic mix of instructor-led presentations, hands-on group and individual exercises, and real-life case studies. Participants will also learn to apply analytical tools in MS Excel to detect and manage fraud.
competencies: Analyzing financial data to detect irregularities.
Utilizing Excel for comprehensive data analysis and fraud control.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define fraud and forensic accounting principles.
Implement fraud prevention measures to reduce organizational risks.
Utilize Microsoft Office tools to identify and report fraudulent activities.
Apply statistical and forensic tools for data analysis.
Support internal audit and senior management in identifying data irregularities.
Leverage Excel to uncover suspicious patterns for further investigation.
Detect fraud and anomalies efficiently using Excel.

items.text: Introduction to fraud and the fraud triangle
Basics of forensic accounting and fraud examination
Corporate governance, ethics, and code of conduct
Fraud detection, response, and prevention strategies
Importing and analyzing data in Excel
Creating reports in Word and PowerPoint
Profiling data using periodic graphs and histograms
Identifying anomalies through digit tests, Chi-Square, and other statistical methods
Advanced tests like second-order and summation tests

outline.title: Identifying Fraud and Anomalies Using Excel

items.text: Applying tests such as largest growth, relative size factor, and correlation analysis
Performing time-series analysis and subset duplication detection
